_about: Boss TROPHIES (polish1 E4, item 131 / 133): cosmetic pieces worn over any outfit in the trophy slot, seen by everyone online (they are part of the look: appearance 'trophies'). Read by core/boss_trophy_db.gd (not data/trophies.json, which is the hub trophy room). spots = the places on the body a piece takes (head, back, arms, legs): pieces that share a spot cannot be worn together, so a boss trophy (head + back) goes with the spectral bracers and greaves but not with the circlet or the shroud. wear = ids of data/characters.json 'wear' (a crown from tools/blender/trophy_wear.py, a mantle sewn by tools/tailor.py from data/wear.json). boss = the Aurelind boss whose first kill gives it (each player's own kill: core/boss_trophy_locker.gd). ghost = drawn as a translucent blue echo (game/echo_look.gd). Every boss trophy has a GHOST copy '<id>_ghost' made by core/boss_trophy_db.gd (same pieces, ghost look), dropped by that boss's phantom (data/fantasy/enemies.json phantom). set 'spectral' = the phantoms' shared set. Names and texts mine, the director's to change.

harvest_king.name: Crown of the Harvest King
harvest_king.about: A woven straw crown of wheat ears and the king's frayed straw mantle.

rootmother.name: Rootmother's Circlet
rootmother.about: Twisting roots that still put out leaves, and a mantle of moss.

tidewarden.name: Tidewarden's Coral Crown
tidewarden.about: Living coral and sea pearls, with a mantle of kelp and scales.

glassmaw.about: Shards of sun-fused glass on a bronze band, and a dune shawl.

rime_colossus.name: Rime Crown
rime_colossus.about: A ring of ice that never melts, and the colossus's frost pelt.

cinderwyrm.name: Wyrm Horns
cinderwyrm.about: The wyrm's swept horns on an ember-cracked band, and a scaled mantle.

tempest_roc.about: A fan of storm feathers over the crown, and a feathered mantle.

pallid_king.name: The Pallid Crown
pallid_king.about: A crown of pale finger bones round a hollow eye, and a long pale shroud.
